name: Recognizing the death of John Davison "Jay" Rockefeller IV, former Senator for the State of West Virginia
official: A resolution recognizing the death of John Davison "Jay" Rockefeller IV, former Senator for the State of West Virginia.

news.title: Senate Honors Former West Virginia Senator Jay Rockefeller

timeline.text: The House received a message from the Senate. The Senate passed H.R. 5254 and H.R. 8454. Senate agreed to S. Res. 959.
timeline.label: Passage
timeline.explain: The real vote on the measure itself.

timeline.text: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S5711-5714; text: CR S5725)
timeline.label: Amendment
timeline.explain: A vote on a proposed change, not on the bill itself.
